title: My first experience in mall world knowing what it is.
content: Hi! I’m very new to mall world stuff and all so if I get something wrong or if this doesn’t seem like mall world please correct me! But last night, I think I had a mall world experience. I was in a school, in the cafeteria, it was kinda long, not so wide and in the middle it had like a long “bench” ig with the food you could buy, and there was one table to the right if you were standing at the “benches” direction, that was the biggest table, there were windows behind the table and there was most people at that table. If you stood by the “bench” looking forward there was a door. And to the left there was more, smaller tables. There was like a soft yellow lighting and the tables were white. I was also in a broken highway after that and the ways were like crossing each other and stuff, my car was the only car on the highway. Does this seem like a mall world experience or something else? Btw at the highway it was like cloudy, but when i looked out the window in the school it was sunny.
